description:
Felix Varela High School is a public high school in Miami that has gone through periodic expansions and campus updates. BDI Construction carried out improvements and contractor work on the campus.

The campus spans roughly 290,000 to 300,000 square feet, with classrooms, an 827-seat theater and auditorium, a 600-seat cafeteria, a media center, science labs, and athletic fields.
